text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Hi, Trainer! The other day, I joined in 
on a street live performance. They said 
anyone could jump in, so I just couldn't 
resist♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
At first, not many people stopped to 
watch, but... The more of an away game it 
is, the more it fires you up, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So I sang "Umapyoi Densetsu" in English! 
Zu-kyun! Do-kyun! Start running your way!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The audience even chimed in with English 
call-and-responses...! And they even gave 
us an encore at the end!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ I'm going to whip up that kind of 
frenzy next time, too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, next time―― It'll be a Winning Live 
with me as center!"
